You assess product quality, identify deviations, and carry out repairs where necessary. You document your findings and discuss them with the relevant colleagues within production. 
In addition, you analyse products returned for repair in order to determine the cause of defects and contribute to structural improvements in the testing and production process. 
What do we expect from you? - You have an MBO or HBO degree in Electrical Engineering and at least 3 years of experience independently testing electrotechnical products. - You are able to read and interpret electrical and mechanical schematics (TPD). - Knowledge of or experience with software programs such as Ceetis, Python, or Omron PLC is considered an advantage. - You have experience testing modules, cables, and smaller control cabinets. - You are accustomed to working in a high-tech environment. - You are motivated by making a significant contribution to product quality standards. - You are flexible, stress-resistant, and work accurately. - You have good communication skills in both Dutch and English. - You are solution-oriented, analytical, and above all, a team player.
